name: 所属先・役職・電話・メールを並べる連絡先テーブル
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Salesforce contacts table body as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the exact extremely wide 1364 by 236 pixel crop and 5.78:1 aspect ratio. Use a single full-width horizontal table, with no vertical blank bands, no card wrapping, and no heading, toolbar, search controls, chart, or surrounding page.

Preserve the same compact light-gray table header and exactly four evenly sized data rows. Keep the source column order and approximate column widths: row number; selection checkbox; Name; Account Name; Title; Phone; Email; Contact Type; and a circular row-action dropdown at the far right. The header has an unchecked select-all box, a blue upward sort arrow after 「名前」, and small blue dropdown chevrons on each column header. The Contact Type column is narrow and its Japanese header should be visibly truncated as 「連絡先...」, matching the source’s clipped “Conta...” label. Each data row begins with its gray row number and an unchecked square checkbox. Each ends with a small outlined circular dropdown button containing a down arrow.

Translate the headers as 「名前」, 「取引先名」, 「役職」, 「電話」, 「メール」, and truncated 「連絡先...」. Preserve the four source records in exact order and retain names, phone numbers, email addresses, and custom contact values exactly:
Row 1: Jane Doe; Dummy associates; 「業務マネージャー」; 848-836-6307; jdoe.mobbin+1@gmail.com; 「ユーザー」.
Row 2: Jane Doe; MBN Company; 「プロダクト担当副社長」; (650) 213-7552; jdoe.mobbin@gmail.com; 「ユーザー」.
Row 3: John Smith; ASMobbin; 「プロジェクトマネージャー」; +1 650 213 7552; jsmith.mobbin+1@gmail.com; ASmit.
Row 4: Sam Lee; ASMobbin; 「営業マネージャー」; 321-311-8930; samlee.mobbin+1@gmail.com; ASmit.

Names, account names, email addresses and contact values are blue links. Role titles and phone numbers are dark gray. Use compact Salesforce-style sans-serif typography, a light-gray header background, thin horizontal gray row separators, white rows, and no vertical cell borders except the subtle header separators. Keep checkboxes, sort arrows, dropdown chevrons, row menus and all text aligned to the source. Preserve the very wide strip composition and all four records. Do not invent data, columns, values, controls or content.
reviewNotes: Japanese contacts table preserves all four records, names, accounts, phone numbers, emails and contact values, with translated headers and role titles. Raw ImageGen output had large blank bands; cropped the table region y=164..524 and resized to 1364x236 to match the source exactly. Side-by-side inspection confirms the columns, row heights and controls remain aligned with no clipped data.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
